items.title: Shopify Mandates IP Allowlisting for Public Apps to Prevent Unauthorized Admin API Access
items.description: Shopify is making IP allowlisting mandatory for public apps that call its Admin API, adding a security check to limit the use of stolen access tokens. Developers must enable the control by November 20, 2026, at 11:59 PM ET. Apps using bulk operations face an earlier deadline of November 12 at the same time. items.title: Microsoft Paint 0-Click Vulnerability Could Allow Hackers to Take Control of Windows PCs
items.description: Microsoft’s Windows Paint vulnerability, CVE-2026-83844, could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute code over a network without user interaction. The flaw carries a CVSS score of 8.1, placing it in the High severity category rather than Critical. items.title: US Government Email Systems Open to Abuse Thanks to Typos
items.description: Erroneous or outdated DNS records can give attackers surprising powers over organizations' email systems.
